topic: Contrast: Present Continuous vs Present Simple (plan vs fact)
scenario: Present Continuous (plan) vs Present Simple (fact/schedule)
en: The train is leaving at 7 PM. (plan/schedule) vs The train leaves at 7 PM every day. (fact)
tr: Tren saat 7'de kalkıyor (plan) vs Tren her gün saat 7'de kalkar (gerçek).
ipa: /ðə treɪn ɪz ˈlivɪŋ æt ˈsɛvən piː ɛm/ /ðə treɪn livz æt ˈsɛvən piː ɛm ˈɛvri deɪ/
trPron: Dı treyn iz livİng at sevın pi em / Dı treyn livz at sevın pi em evri dey
collocations: is leaving at, leaves at every day
commonMistake: The train is leaving at 7 PM every day. ❌
aiExplain: InformativePresent continuous gelecek planı, present simple ise düzenli tarifeyi ifade eder.
grammarTags: present-continuous-future, contrast, plan-vs-fact
